name: help conditional on the helper's own work and spare hands
what_it_changes: P16 says rooms help one another, trade help and turn requests away. In these rooms help waits on conditions the statement does not hold: the helper's own work must be safe or finished, the helper must have pixels and time to spare, and the terms (space, non-interference, recognizable help) must hold.
why: Cut rules R1 and R2 (tree-D4.md), with R1a (the level): the key's lines, read whole in _analysis/d4a02_keys/add-condition_P16_T4-017.txt, state one shared change to P16. R1a: T3-011 holds 12 of the 30 rooms and T3-151 10, so the branch is declared at the fourth order. 'Offered aid depends on keeping one's own work secure and having placements to spare' (OnePiece); 'Outgoing help receives turns only when the home plot needs no correction' (hentai); 'Help is offered explicitly on condition that the neighbour does not interfere with the host's work' (shishamo). These are the labelers' how sentences.
